text:
Ava (CFO): Posting a compact follow-up from today's all-hands on budget/runway. Short version: runway ~12 months under current plan, hiring limited to prioritized roles, and a small set of procurement changes to speed approvals. Drop questions here.
Omar (Eng): Quick question: are we doing a hard hiring freeze? Need to know for replacement planning.
Ava (CFO): Not a hard freeze. We're approving only critical replacements and high-impact infra roles. For new headcount open a brief 2-line justification and tag Priya + Sasha.
Priya (Head of Product): Product role approvals must include which OKR they move. Use the one-line template on the hiring page.
Sasha (Finance Ops): Procurement thresholds revised to reduce churn: p-card <= $4k, PO with manager approval $4k-$60k, exec signoff required > $60k. Vendor Ops will triage mid-tier requests to speed turnaround.
Zoe (Vendor Ops): We'll keep a prioritized vendor list. If a vendor is on the list, approvals are fast-track. Add me to intake forms to flag priority vendors.
Omar (Eng): Emergency infra burst last week cost us ~35k. For incidents, who can approve immediate spend?
Sasha (Finance Ops): Emergency approvals: on-call tech lead + Eng manager can greenlight up to $30k immediately. For $30k-$100k, SRE director + Finance verbal ok. Anything over $100k needs exec signoff. Must notify Finance within 8 hours and file a retro.
Ava (CFO): We moved the notification window to 8 hours to shorten reconciliation time.
Omar (Eng): How will reserved infra prepayments affect runway?
Sasha (Finance Ops): We amortize prepaid commitments monthly in runway. One-liner: `monthly_amort = prepaid_amount / commitment_months`. See the amortization tab in the finance runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/finance/runway-amort.
Priya (Head of Product): Will Q3 product budgets be reforecasted with these controls?
Ava (CFO): Yes. We'll run a reforecast meeting next Thursday. Product should bring 2 scenarios: (A) current roadmap with deferrals listed, (B) minimal deltas focusing on revenue initiatives.
procurement-bot: Vendor intake submitted by Priya (Head of Product): https://forms.internal/vendor/907 - est $22,000 - status: pending vendor ops review.
payroll-bot: Headcount note: monthly headcount growth capped to 2% unless exception approved by People Ops + Finance.
Sasha (Finance Ops): Action items: Sasha to publish updated procurement flow and quick FAQ by EOD Tue; Zoe to publish prioritized vendor list; Priya to circulate the hiring justification template. Finance office hours scheduled Fri 10am PT.
Ava (CFO): Thanks all. If you have edge cases (renewals, legal-heavy SOWs, or urgent partner spend), tag `urgent-finance` in the intake and cc Sasha + Zoe.
End of thread.
